jobs.location: Boulder, Colorado, United States of America
jobs.description: Company: Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. Job Area: Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Modem Technologies Software General Summary: *** This position is not eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship.*** Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G — ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5G's potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age — and this is where you come in. The Modem Systems Software team builds the low-level firmware and protocol software that powers cellular connectivity across billions of devices worldwide — spanning smartphones, automotive, IoT, fixed wireless access, and next-generation 5G/6G platforms. We are re-imagining how modem software is designed, built, verified, and maintained in an AI-native paradigm, where large language models, agentic tooling, and machine-assisted engineering are first-class parts of the development lifecycle. As a Modem Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize real-time embedded software for Qualcomm's modem subsystem (MPSS). You will work close to the metal — writing performant, resource-constrained C/C++ that runs on DSP and Arm cores across cellular protocol layers, device drivers, and RTOS-level components. Beyond traditional embedded development, this role is explicitly AI-native . You are expected to leverage, build, and improve AI-assisted development workflows — using code-generation agents, LLM-based code review, automated test synthesis, log/crash triage assistants, and retrieval-augmented tooling over our codebase — to dramatically accelerate delivery, quality, and debugging in a highly complex firmware environment. Principal Duties and Responsibilities: Design, implement, and optimize real-time embedded modem software across protocol layers, drivers, and platform services, meeting strict latency, memory, and power constraints. Apply rigorous data-structure and algorithm design to build efficient, scalable firmware components. Own end-to-end feature delivery: requirements, architecture, implementation, unit/integration testing, on-target bring-up, and maintenance. Pioneer AI-native development practices within the team — integrate AI coding agents into daily workflows, establish agent rules and prompt patterns, and measurably reduce development and debug cycle time. Build and maintain AI-assisted tooling for code review, static analysis, test synthesis, and automated crash/log triage over the modem codebase. Debug and root-cause complex, multi-layer issues on target hardware, increasingly leveraging AI-assisted analysis of logs, traces, and RAM dumps. Collaborate cross-functionally with systems, hardware, test, and integration teams to deliver production-quality modem firmware. Contribute to code reviews, design reviews, and continuous improvement of engineering standards — including standards for the responsible and effective use of AI in the SDLC. Mentor peers on both embedded fundamentals and AI-native engineering techniques. Minimum Qualifications: • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field. Preferred Qualifications Core Embedded & Systems Engineering Strong command of data structures and algorithms with the ability to reason about time/space complexity in memory- and cycle-constrained environments. Deep understanding of operating systems concepts : scheduling, concurrency, interrupts, memory management, IPC, real-time constraints, and RTOS internals (e.g., QuRT, ThreadX, FreeRTOS, or similar). Proven programming proficiency in modern C/C++ (C++17 and beyond), including performance optimization, cache-aware design, and lock-free/thread-safe patterns. Experience with embedded software on DSP and Arm architectures , including familiarity with SIMD/vectorization, DMA, and low-power design. Experience with debugging on target hardware — JTAG, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, crash-dump / RAM-dump analysis, and log parsing. Familiarity with device drivers, HAL layers, boot flows, and hardware/software co-design. AI-Native Engineering AI-first mindset : you treat AI tooling as a core engineering multiplier, not an afterthought. You default to designing workflows where an AI agent does the first draft of code, tests, and analysis, and the engineer curates, validates, and hardens. Experience using AI coding assistants and agentic tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cline, Claude/GPT-based agents) to generate, refactor, and review embedded C/C++ at scale. Ability to build and maintain AI-augmented developer workflows : prompt libraries, agent rules, retrieval-augmented context over large firmware codebases, and MCP-style tool integrations. Experience applying LLMs to crash triage, log summarization, root-cause analysis, and automated defect classification in complex embedded systems. Interest in AI-assisted test generation and verification — synthesizing unit/integration tests, fuzzing harnesses, and coverage-driven test expansion for modem software. Comfort evaluating AI output critically: understanding hallucination risks, validating generated code against timing/memory budgets, and enforcing safety and correctness in real-time firmware. Bonus: experience fine-tuning, prompt-engineering, or building tooling around code models; familiarity with embedding/vector search over source repositories. jobs.title: PE Software Engineer
jobs.location: Santa Clara, California, United States of America
jobs.description: Company: Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. Job Area: Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Software Engineering General Summary: Are you excited about developing advanced GNSS and positioning technologies that power billions of devices worldwide? Qualcomm's Location Technology Team is looking for highly motivated software engineers to design and deliver next-generation positioning solutions for future wireless platforms. Qualcomm's advanced GNSS and location technologies are deeply integrated into our chipsets and enable accurate, reliable, and power-efficient positioning across mobile, wearable, automotive, IoT, and other connected platforms. As a GNSS Positioning Engine Software Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, development, implementation, testing, and optimization of Qualcomm's core GNSS Positioning Engine. The Positioning Engine is responsible for transforming GNSS measurements and sensor inputs into high-accuracy Position, Velocity, and Time (PVT) solutions used across Qualcomm platforms. You will work closely with GNSS systems, measurement engine, sensor, hardware, software, and test teams to develop and commercialize state-of-the-art positioning technologies that deliver industry-leading location performance. The role also leverages modern AI-assisted engineering tools and workflows, including large language models (LLMs) and coding assistants such as Claude, Codex, and similar technologies, to improve software development productivity, code quality, debugging efficiency, data analysis, and system performance optimization. Role Responsibilities In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, testing, maintenance, and optimization of real-time embedded GNSS positioning software. Key responsibilities include: Design, develop, review, and maintain production-quality GNSS Positioning Engine software in C/C++. Implement and optimize GNSS positioning algorithms, including Weighted Least Squares (WLS), Kalman Filtering (KF/EKF), and Position/Velocity/Time (PVT) estimation. Develop algorithms and software for processing GNSS measurements, including pseudorange, Doppler, carrier-phase, satellite ephemeris, clock, atmospheric, and other measurement corrections. Develop and optimize GNSS/INS and multi-sensor fusion algorithms using inertial sensors and other positioning technologies. Contribute to advanced positioning technologies including multi-frequency GNSS, hybrid positioning, sensor-assisted navigation, AI/ML-enhanced positioning solutions and emerging XR use cases . Work closely with GNSS systems engineers to translate positioning algorithms and system concepts into efficient, robust, production-quality embedded software. Collaborate with the GNSS Measurement Engine team to consume and process GNSS observables and optimize end-to-end positioning performance. Develop robust algorithms for satellite selection, measurement weighting, outlier detection and rejection, fault detection, integrity monitoring, and positioning error mitigation. Analyze and improve positioning accuracy, availability, robustness, convergence time, and reliability under challenging GNSS environments including urban canyons, indoor, and high-dynamic scenarios. Diagnose and resolve complex system-level positioning and performance issues using GNSS measurements, logs, simulations, and field-test data. Develop software within a real-time, multi-threaded embedded architecture, including inter-process communication and multiple software and firmware interfaces. Contribute to software architecture, interface design, design reviews, code reviews, unit testing, and development methodology. Optimize positioning software for CPU/MIPS utilization, memory footprint, latency, and power efficiency. Work closely with systems, software, firmware, hardware, validation, and product teams to commercialize positioning technologies across Qualcomm platforms. Minimum Qualifications: • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience. OR Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience. OR PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field. • 2+ years of academic or work experience with Programming Language such as C, C++, Java, Python, etc. Preferred Qualifications Strong understanding of GNSS positioning fundamentals, navigation algorithms, and PVT estimation. Experience with Weighted Least Squares (WLS), Kalman Filters (KF/EKF), estimation theory, statistical signal processing, or optimization techniques. Experience implementing GNSS positioning and navigation algorithms in embedded or real-time software systems. Experience using AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., Claude, Codex, or similar technologies) for coding, debugging, performance analysis, test automation, and engineering productivity is highly desirable. Understanding of GNSS measurements and error sources, including pseudorange, Doppler, carrier phase, satellite clock and orbit errors, ionosphere, troposphere, multipath, and receiver measurement errors. Experience with GNSS/INS integration and multi-sensor fusion. Familiarity with GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou, QZSS, and multi-frequency GNSS. Experience with robust estimation, measurement weighting, outlier rejection, integrity monitoring, and fault detection techniques. Knowledge of RTK, PPP, carrier-phase positioning, or other precise positioning technologies. Understanding of navigation filter tuning, covariance modeling, uncertainty estimation, and performance characterization. Experience analyzing GNSS logs, measurement data, simulation outputs, and large-scale field-test datasets. Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS), multi-threaded software architectures, and ARM-based development/debugging. Experience with debugging and profiling tools such as TRACE32. Experience using MATLAB, Python, or Perl for algorithm development, simulation, automation, and data analysis. Experience optimizing embedded software for computational complexity, memory usage, latency, and power consumption. Ability to understand the end-to-end GNSS receiver and positioning architecture, from measurement generation through the final position solution. Familiarity with Android location architecture, mobile positioning systems, or connected-device location technologies. Experience applying AI/ML techniques to positioning, navigation, or sensor fusion problems is a plus. Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively across software, systems, and test teams. Why Join Qualcomm Location Technology? Qualcomm's GNSS and positioning technologies power devices used by billions of consumers worldwide. Our innovations enable navigation, fitness tracking, emergency services, automotive applications, wearables, and emerging location-based experiences across a wide range of connected platforms. As part of the Location Technology Team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge positioning solutions, collaborate with leading experts in GNSS and navigation technologies, and help shape the future of location experiences for next-generation wireless products.
